title: MT61301: Applied Ferrous Thermodynamics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction, Definition of thermodynamic terms, First law of thermodynamics,
Heat capacity and enthalpy, Second law of thermodynamics and entropy, Auxiliary
function, Maxwellâs relations, Transformation formula, Gibbs-Helmholtz
equation, Third law of thermodynamics, Fugacity, Activity and equilibrium
constant, Ellingham- Richardson diagram, Thermodynamics of solutions,
Interaction parameter with respect to iron and steel making. Thermodynamics of
slag-metal reaction, Phase rule, phase equilibria and free energy-composition
diagram. Applications to various problems in industry.
